title: A Happy Place - East Nash *minutes to Broadway
description:
If you’ve ever been told to “find a happy place,” look no further — we’ve got you covered. Our stylish Airbnb with retro flair and party accessories is exactly what you need for your next getaway, bachelor/bachelorette party, or fun with family and friends. Complete with remote-controlled disco balls, Bluetooth karaoke, a preloaded NES station, kids activities, board games, a color-changing fireplace, and a rooftop deck with outdoor dining, firepit, and mounted TV, it’s sure to be a good time.

The space
This home features a 2-car garage, open floor plan, floor-to-ceiling windows, hardwood floors, and a modern kitchen with quartz countertops and stainless appliances.The highlight is a large private rooftop deck with outdoor TV —ideal for entertaining or relaxing under the stars.
